run.name: DroidDesk
commands: xcodebuild -project DroidDesk.xcodeproj -scheme DroidDesk -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath .derivedData build && APP=.derivedData/Build/Products/Debug/DroidDesk.app && touch "$APP" && /System/Library/Frameworks/CoreServices.framework/Frameworks/LaunchServices.framework/Support/lsregister -f "$APP" && open "$APP"
